backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing game library management with user profiles, favorites, ratings, comments, and admin controls using authorization and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (homepage, search, filters, carousels, thumbnails, game details, etc.) to source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files describing their purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH-based dark theme color system with custom CSS variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, game detail, favorites, recently played, leaderboard, admin, and franchise pages, wrapped in QueryClient and ThemeProvider.
Comments component with form for posting new comments, list display with timestamps, and edit/delete functionality for comment owners.
frontend/src/components/FavoriteButton.t: Heart icon button component that toggles game favorite status with animation, requiring authentication and showing toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying Game Hub branding, quick navigation links (Home, Leaderboard), social media icons, and copyright notice with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/GameCarousel.tsx: Horizontal scrollable carousel component that displays a list of game thumbnails with a title, using ScrollArea for smooth horizontal scrolling.
frontend/src/components/GameFilters.tsx: Filter controls component with dropdown selects for genre, year, franchise, and sport, plus a clear button to reset all active filters.
frontend/src/components/GameRating.tsx: Interactive star rating component showing average game rating and allowing authenticated users to submit their own 1-5 star rating.
frontend/src/components/GameThumbnail.ts: Game card component displaying cover image, title, genre badge, release year, favorite button, and optional NEW/TRENDING badges with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main navigation header with Game Hub logo, navigation links (Home, Leaderboard), authentication button, and user dropdown menu with profile options and admin access.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component wrapping Header, main content outlet, Footer, and ProfileSetupModal for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts new authenticated users to enter their name for profile creation, blocking interaction until completed.
frontend/src/components/SearchBar.tsx: Search input component with magnifying glass icon for filtering games by text query.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance, handling authentication state changes and initializing admin access control with secret token.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity storage, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including game CRUD, user profiles, favorites, and play tracking, with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for dark theme colors, border radius, and glow utility classes for cyan, blue, and purple effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin-only page for managing games with CRUD operations, displaying a table of games with edit/delete actions and a form dialog for creating/updating games.
frontend/src/pages/FavoritesPage.tsx: Displays the current user's favorited games in a grid layout, filtering from all games based on the user's favorites list.
frontend/src/pages/FranchisePage.tsx: Shows all games belonging to a specific franchise (from URL param), sorted by release year in descending order.
frontend/src/pages/GameDetailPage.tsx: Detailed game view with hero section, play button, favorite toggle, rating component, comments section, and related games carousel based on genre or franchise.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main homepage component with hero banner, search bar, game filters (genre, year, franchise, sport), and three game carousels (trending, new releases, popular) with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Displays ranked leaderboard table showing players by total play count with trophy icons for top 3, highlighting current user's row, and fetching user profiles for display names.
frontend/src/pages/RecentlyPlayedPage.ts: Shows user's recently played games (up to 20) in a grid layout by fetching user profile and matching game IDs with full game data.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup methods for managing parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, container settings, extended theme with animations (accordion), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a game library website with 500+ titles, architectural notes (frontend/backend stack, database structure), feature list with IDs, and image requirements for hero banner and placeholders.
